'''Moh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] member of the [[Uggli Brothers]] gang. On [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], after a brawl with [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Jariah Syn]], Skywalker used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to force Moh to lick his boots clean, which disturbed Syn.<ref name="Legacy 35" />
